releases.title: 优化代码块功能
content: 新增内容块操作菜单，支持新增、上下移动、复制文本、生成副本和删除内容块。
新增表格快捷工具栏，支持增删行列、切换表头、合并或拆分单元格及删除表格。
优化超链接插入与编辑体验，支持打开、编辑、复制和取消链接，并限制为安全链接类型。
新增附件卡片，展示文件名称、类型和大小，并可使用系统默认应用打开。
新增附件处理设置，可选择引用原文件或复制到文档同级 assets 目录。
新增附件复制实时进度，复制失败时自动清理不完整文件。
支持将粘贴和选择的图片保存到 assets 目录，并改进本地图片预览。
优化附件和视频的 Markdown 兼容性，其他编辑器也可识别并打开对应文件。
优化本地视频加载，支持流式播放，并在媒体内容后自动保留可继续输入的段落。
新增未保存文档关闭确认，并在文件被其他程序修改时提示保存冲突，避免误覆盖内容。
支持网页链接使用系统浏览器打开、本地链接按当前文档目录安全访问。
优化富文本与源码模式切换，按文档记忆编辑模式并保持阅读位置。
增强扩展 Markdown 语法兼容性，无法识别的内容块可原样保留。
优化文件访问权限校验和异步读写，提升本地文件操作的安全性与稳定性。
contentEn: Added a block action menu for inserting, moving up or down, copying text, duplicating, and deleting blocks.
Added a table toolbar for adding or removing rows and columns, toggling the header row, merging or splitting cells, and deleting tables.
Improved link insertion and editing: open, edit, copy, and remove links, restricted to safe link types.
Added attachment cards showing file name, type, and size, openable with the system default application.
Added attachment handling settings: reference the original file or copy it to an assets folder next to the document.
Added live copy progress for attachments; incomplete files are cleaned up automatically on failure.
Pasted and selected images can be saved to the assets folder; improved local image preview.
Improved Markdown compatibility for attachments and videos so other editors can recognize and open the files.
Improved local video loading with streaming playback and an editable paragraph kept after media content.
Added a confirmation when closing unsaved documents and a save-conflict warning when files change externally, preventing accidental overwrites.
Web links open in the system browser; local links are accessed safely relative to the current document folder.
Improved switching between rich text and source mode: the editor mode is remembered per document and the reading position is preserved.
Improved compatibility with extended Markdown syntax; unrecognized blocks are preserved as-is.
Improved file access permission checks and asynchronous I/O for safer, more stable local file operations.
